rows.new: "Number activation": only active channels of that type; free on one side, in use by another bot on the other
"Connected" on the card is the bot with an ACTIVE channel of that type; disconnected or another type is "Connect"
"Conteúdos" is the `resources` entry on the permission list, not `contents`
"No permission" disappears from the bar, and the destination stays the same as always
analytics leads to the contact's OWN analytics, under its own type prefix
search matches by name and email, case-insensitively
search filters by name and excludes what is already a service
the card's Queues column is comma-separated without spaces, matching the capture
the fullest column takes the height, with 30 between nodes
the test conversation depends on WhatsApp, and only then offers the Desk
the permissions page's description has the three variants from the source
block choice only shows before choosing, with a category and outside Authentication
expiration is shown as day/month/year, counted in UTC
the list shows unavailable without WhatsApp, empty without templates, and the list with templates
the channel page: connected, not connected, or the bot already has ANOTHER channel (Pipe's decision)
the first key is the default, and the default cannot be deleted
the first matching rule wins, and the order is the one on the screen
a tenant-scoped rule does not appear in the queue's section
the rule is spelled out in full with the combinator visible
the queue's section only sees that queue's rules
the week starts on Sunday, the way Postgres counts it
the URL must be HTTPS with a domain and cannot repeat
a hidden tab stays in the row, just invisible
addGlobalAction rejects past the limit of 15, same as block actions
grouping from the URL falls back to "none" when it is not in the catalog
applying multiple values keeps repeats where the query allows it
applying one chip preserves the other parameters, including search and tab
applyGlobals marks dirty without touching the canvas undo stack
a file too short to have a signature does not throw
tags become a single comma-separated column
the flow's permissions hide what the person cannot see
quotes in the value come out doubled
Attendance still lands on the internal monitoring route
authentication skips the text (the message is fixed) but requires a language
low cuts in front of no-priority
search and filter add up, and no queue checked means all of them
an unknown header is treated as no media
each card shows the permission it requires, and only that one
the contact's extra field is read via a dotted path
a free-form field only passes with a usable attribute key
fieldForLinkError: an unknown code does not point to any field
fieldForLinkError: nome_obrigatorio goes to the name field
fieldForLinkError: the four URL codes go to the destination field
Channels leads to the contact's OWN channels, under its own type prefix
a channel flagged for reauthorization is in progress, not done
the block card shows content, entry and custom actions without repeating
stamps the message as day - time and translates the ticket's state
pasting actions preserves origin, creates unique ids and respects the limit atomically
the AND combinator requires every condition
the OR combinator only needs one condition
counts like the source: singular up to 1, "Approximately" above that
Contacts and Content open their areas within the contact's context
a conversation with no queue falls back to the tenant rule, not to "no rule"
a conversation with no creation marker goes to the end of its tier
an invitation without acceptance is in progress; someone beyond the admin is done
copies a block to the clipboard and pastes a copy at the chosen position
creates, moves and deletes a block, removing destinations that pointed to it
create requires a name and respects the limit, in that order
Ctrl+Z disappears while a block is being dragged, so the drag's undo is not lost
a URL date only passes in the format Postgres accepts, and only if it exists on the calendar
discards the header and reads phone, name and parameters by position
a long duration returns a dash for absence, not "NaNmin"
duration only shows the hour once there is an hour
edit has the five literal states and derives the selector from the matrix
an order tie is broken by identifier, not by the database order
scale and score become a fraction of their own ceiling
hides the redirect when the service is the main one
hides only the expiration when the redirect is persistent
a negative step returns the next step's raw count
fatal only fails with a known fraction below the maximum
a queue with no agent does not count: the conversation would arrive and no one would receive it
filters by template name and state at the same time
filterSystemVariables searches the name and the description
a URL filter that is not a UUID becomes "no filter", never a query
Growth and Log open their screens within the contact's context
wasDragged: only counts a real drag, not a click that jittered a pixel
repeated languages across translations are flagged
import: in progress, failed and completed-without-accepted do not close the step
toggles an edge on and off without duplicating the output's condition
clearing the list preserves the operation's queue filter
clearing filters stays on the current bot's monitoring
clearing only the current filter preserves the others
globalActionList returns an empty list when the key does not exist
keeps the outputs' condition order because the first matching condition wins
buildDrawing exports the screen's blocks and the global actions without changing the map
no matching rule returns null — the conversation goes to the default queue
a name that does not start with a letter is rejected, matching their service
exportFileName sanitizes the flow's name and is never empty
a score outside the scale gets no class — it never becomes a detractor by accident
the "back" step only exists on the first translation, with a block chosen and no other translations
a connection's target is resolved from the block's box, without depending on the DOM element under the cursor
the file starts with a BOM
the file must be a .pfx up to 10MB
the header carries the ten columns, in order
the list card leads to the channel page inside the bot, under its own type prefix
the status chip: valid -> success, expired -> disabled, no file -> default
the capture's contract sees seven tabs, in the template's order
the denominator shows the population and what was left out
the offset is 1 with media and 0 without
sending only unlocks with name, category, block and complete translations
the queue filter is OR: whoever is in Support shows up even if also in Default
the flow keeps the two the router loses
the new-key form opens up to the limit of 3; at the limit it becomes a warning banner
the Manager falls back to `default` when the cluster has no key of its own
the Manager navigates the flow's current tree
the Enable switch only unlocks with the first URL filled in and valid
the router template's item does not go through the permission sieve
the block menu follows the flags: in Pipe they are text/image/document and video
demo mode shows the entire catalog, even with no permission at all
the template's name follows /^[a-z]([a-z0-9_])*$/, up to 512, and never repeats
the filter panel offers the list's own queues, without repeats and in order
the manager's period repeats differenceInDays and the 90-day ceiling
what the screen accepts is what the database has a check constraint for
the rest of the row is the same in both, and in the same order
the router opens with "Services", the template's item
the router offers neither Builder nor Attendance
the channel's label in the list is the number and the name; without a number, just the name
the bulk-edit title agrees in number
the five visible ones are the order measured in the source
the groups come out from largest to smallest
the three account roles have their labels and icons, in the source's order
payment is only available for Utility templates
attendance role is not account role, and a raw name never becomes a label
a percentage rounds to an integer and rejects anything that is not a number
an unknown period in the URL falls back to "Today"
the default period covers the last 7 days, from 00:00 to 23:59
puts the contact on the right and the bot/agent on the left
a semicolon inside the field does not open a new column
by tag, the conversation enters every tag it has
by queue, whoever has no queue gets its own group instead of disappearing
ProcessHttp edits headers in pairs and keeps the flow's object
whoever edits the flow through the ACCOUNT still sees the entire row
an empty output draft stays on the card and does not enter the publish alert
an active rule with no condition never matches, and is flagged as unreachable
the queue rule beats the tenant rule
summarizes unique recipients and delivery states
period label and the comparison hint
selection discards IDs missing from the visible list without changing the input
multiple selection survives submission and reopening, including in old links
with no grouping, a single group comes out with the entire list
with no conversation, only the header comes out
with no media only text remains; with everything on, payment and carousel enter the second row
with no account permission at all, no card appears
with no active rule the pill disappears, and never becomes "WITHIN"
sites: a round trip preserves order and removes duplicate/empty entries
only advances with a description and the whole URL filled in and valid
only a media header consumes position 1
only targets with a known prefix and a filled-in id pass
a freshly provisioned tenant: six steps, in onboarding order, all pending
exportText produces {flow, globalActions} with the block keyed by id
textToEmails accepts line breaks and ignores empty ones
textToEmails of empty text is an empty list
textToEmails splits by comma, trims spaces and lowercases
every header in the catalog has a decided offset
the panel's validation flags the entry's required fields before saving
validateImport accepts a valid export and returns the map ready to load
validateImport rejects JSON that does not match the editor's export format
validateImport rejects text that is not JSON
validateImport rejects a flow with no root block
a value outside the scale does not become zero — it becomes unknown
variation: equal is zero, previous zero is infinite, absent is undefined
userVariables returns an empty list when the flow references no context variable
userVariables merges context variables from blocks and global actions, without repeating
